bio: This bistro, steeped in big-boned flavours, has acquired a loyal crowd of regulars! Thierry Blanqui finds inspiration in tradition, devising new takes on dishes like roast leeks, green apple dressing and poached skate wing; lamb stew with turnips, beetroot, dates and lemon or his iconic rum baba with a light vanilla cream! Poised between tradition and modernity, it ticks all the boxes!
